title: Use of standpipes for purposes other than supplying water for firefighting.
officialText:
Standpipes may be used for a purpose
other than to supply water for firefighting operations, including but not limited to supplying water or compressed air for
construction or demolition operations, subject to the approval of the Fire Department and provided at least one standpipe riser is
maintained at all times for firefighting operations. Where the standpipe is used to supply water for construction or demolition
operations and freezing conditions may occur, the standpipe shall be completely drained after use to prevent freezing.
